notes: Read SKILL.md and references/link-architecture-patterns.md, linking-example.md, linking-templates.md, mermaid-templates.md, site-type-patterns.md in full. Two modes: `architecture` designs page hierarchy, URL taxonomy, navigation, hub/spoke clusters and a Mermaid site map; `linking` analyses an existing internal link graph (orphans, anchor mix, authority flow) and outputs a source/target/anchor plan; both give a /100 structure score.

Produces plans and diagrams only; the user implements link, redirect, or noindex changes, and the skill stops to ask before recommending deletion/noindex/redirect of a high-value orphan (SKILL.md:127). Saves to memory/seo-geo/tune/site-structure-optimizer/ after asking (SKILL.md:144). SKILL.md:68-69 suggest optional helpers `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/connectors/crawl.py|linkgraph.py"` and link-architecture-patterns.md:55 references them for orphan detection; they do not ship with this skill, and SKILL.md:65 states 'Every step works manually from a provided page list'. Crawled HTML is treated as untrusted (SKILL.md:75). No installs or credentials.

Paid tools (~~web crawler, ~~SEO tool, ~~analytics) are optional. Non-shipping optional pointers: ../../../references/skill-contract.md (handoff shape, termination), ../../../CONNECTORS.md, ../../../SECURITY.md, ../../../scripts/connectors/README.md, and sibling skills on-page-seo-checker and content-quality-auditor (the latter is excluded from this batch, so its hand-off target will be absent).
